cases.rationale: The large road vehicle has a continuous bus body, passenger windows and a bus wheel. The animals and food-like motifs are printed advertisements on its side, so they do not establish actual animals, plush toys or food. The overhead pole is a street lamp rather than an identifiable traffic signal. No unresolved category ambiguity remains after considering all 75 definitions.

Several actual sheep stand and graze in the grass by the river; their compact pale woolly bodies, dark faces and sheep proportions are visible. These are not cattle or horses. The remaining crop consists of water, grass and forest, with no identifiable object from the other definitions. No unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The produce display contains unmistakable yellow banana bunches and a large pile of round orange citrus fruit. The red and green round produce at the left does not resolve apple versus other fruit or tomatoes, so apple is unclear. A small gray and flesh-colored fragment behind the produce at the far right could belong to a person but is insufficiently distinct, so person is unclear. The pale clustered heads are cauliflower rather than broccoli; the display is a produce counter rather than a dining table. All 75 definitions were considered.

An actual zebra's striped head, upright mane and ears fill the right side. A human hand and arm extend from the upper left. The lower foreground and upper-right framing show the car's window opening and interior door trim. The zebra is distinguishable from a horse, and the remaining background is grass, road and trees. No unresolved category ambiguity remains after considering all 75 definitions.

The cook's face, torso, forearms and hands identify an actual person. The tiny containers on the rear work surface have insufficient neck/body detail to resolve bottle identity, so bottle is unclear. Hanging round-headed kitchen utensils could be spoons or ladles and are too small to distinguish, so spoon is unclear. A blurred metal basin/tap-like area at lower left does not securely establish a sink, so sink is unclear. The cropped hand activity does not reveal an identifiable knife blade and handle; the work surface is not a dining table. All 75 definitions were considered.

A person cuts an avocado with a visible knife. A glass bottle with neck and label stands above a microwave; the separate small toaster oven above it has an oven door and controls. The foreground contains an open metal bowl and a wooden spoon with bowl and handle, and a pair of scissors lies behind the cutting area. The avocado and bread-like item do not establish any listed fruit or sandwich category. The utensil holder is not an identifiable drinking cup, and this is a kitchen work counter rather than a dining table. No unresolved category ambiguity remains after considering all 75 definitions.

A real sleeping tabby cat rests beside two handheld remote controls with visible button layouts. The floral upholstered support has a cushion/back appearance, but this tight crop does not resolve an individual armchair versus a couch, so chair and couch remain unclear. It does not show a bed frame or mattress context. The button devices are remotes rather than phones, keyboards or computer mice. All 75 definitions were considered.

Two actual ceramic vases with rounded bodies and narrow openings stand on a cubby display shelf. Their decorative vessel form supports vase rather than bottle, cup or plant pot. The suspended carousel horses are miniatures/ornaments and therefore do not count as actual horses. The shelf is not identifiable dining furniture. No unresolved category ambiguity remains after considering all 75 definitions.

An actual baseball player stands on the field, and rows of individual stadium chair seats/backs are visible along the upper edge. The small dark object at the player's hand could be a fielding glove, but the hand/object detail is inadequate to identify a mitt securely, so baseball glove is unclear despite the baseball context. The advertisements are printed graphics, and the small white ball has no corresponding supplied category. All 75 definitions were considered.

Several actual passenger cars are on the cross street, and identifiable red/green traffic-signal heads stand beside the intersection. The white vehicle is a panel van without a recognizable truck bed or lorry body. Tiny dark upright fragments on the far sidewalk could include a pedestrian, but cannot be resolved from posts and street fixtures, so person remains unclear. Road railings do not show a bench seat, and the overhead wires alone do not establish a train. All 75 definitions were considered.

Several actual zebras, including a smaller foal, have clearly visible striped bodies, heads, legs and upright manes. Their identity is zebra rather than horse or generic striped objects. The remaining visible material is rock, ground and patches of snow, without another identifiable supplied category. No unresolved category ambiguity remains after considering all 75 definitions.

A man wears a striped necktie and holds a large open ceramic soup bowl/tureen; a small ceramic drinking cup is partly visible at the lower left. The circular item in his raised hand is a lid/saucer rather than a drinking vessel or another bowl. A thin utensil extends from his other hand toward the bowl, but the spoon bowl and handle cannot both be identified clearly, so spoon remains unclear. The wall's printed writing is not a bound book, and no dining tabletop is identifiable in the crop. All 75 definitions were considered.
